thread:
marta: Heads-up — I pushed a new Grafana rollup: kv_hitpattern_heatmap (per-model, per-route). Saw a weird dip on the canary (model=v3.2-canary) where hit rate drops sharply after offset ~1024 and p99 token latency jumps ~40ms.
devin: link? curious if it's kv eviction or kernel change.
marta: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/xyZ/kv-hitpattern 
Query used: `avg_over_time(kv.hit_rate{model=~\".*v3.2.*\",route=~\"/chat.*\"}[5m]) by (offset_bucket,model,route)` and `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token.latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,model,route))` — overlayed heatmaps.
ryan: saw a kernel-selection change landed in the canary yesterday (PR #6789) that tweaks kernel thresholds for long sequences. Could be switching to the new fused-attn kernel which has worse KV lookup locality?
anya: I recorded a couple of sampled traces. For requests with prefixes > 1k tokens the runtime picks kernel=fused_attn_v2 and kv.hit_rate drops from ~0.92 to ~0.64. The flame shows extra memcpy between batches.
marta: yeah the correlation is tight: offsets 0-1024 stable, >1024 hit-rate down and p99 up. Also batch_shape histogram shifted — canary batches have higher variance (more long tails).
devin: is it a batching heuristic regression or kernel path micro-inefficiency? Two possible levers: 1) force old kernel for sequences >512 until we fix memcpy, or 2) tweak continuous-batching threshold so long sequences go into dedicated smaller batches.
ryan: I ran a microbench: fused_attn_v2 throughput is slightly better on short seqs but drops 20% on >1024 when KV present. Hypothesis: fused kernel optimizes attention but introduces non-coalesced KV loads.
anya: patch idea: add metric `kernel.kv_missed_loads` (counter) and tag by kernel name + model_version. Quick instrumentation so we can A/B numerically rather than eyeballing heatmap.
marta: good — also adding per-route p75/p95/p99 token latency panels broken out by model_version (canary vs prod) + kv_hit_rate overlay. Want granular route tag (route=/chat/stream vs /chat/complete).
devin: can we limit canary rollout? current weight is 10%. If long-context routes are sensitive maybe scale back to 2% for now.
ryan: lowered traffic to 2% at 17:24 UTC (infra-bot event below). Will keep telemetry up.
infra-bot: deploy: rollback-weight - model=v3.2-canary from 10% -> 2% by ryan at 1711122540
anya: I'll add the `kernel.kv_missed_loads` counter and a debug tag to the existing traces. ETA ~2h.
marta: thanks. Next steps: 1) instrument missed loads + batch-shape variance, 2) run controlled microbench for >1024 prefixes, 3) update dashboard panels and add an alert if p99 delta (canary vs prod) > 20ms for any route.
devin: ping me when the alert exists — we'll hard-stop rollout if it fires.
marta: noted. saving panel snapshots and will post baseline screenshots in #eng-runtime after instrumentation. :camera_flash:
